title: Design System: Phantom Workspace — Lienzo protagonista

provenance.verification: Checks controlled by Phantom; independent visual review pending. No approval claimed.

behavior.sidebarPreference: phantom:sidebar-collapsed; global localStorage boolean; expanded by default; storage failure preserves session interaction
behavior.drawer: Independent temporary state at <=850px; inert while hidden; Tab containment; Escape/scrim/selection return focus to trigger; breakpoint clears blocking
behavior.terminal: No remount or transform animation for sidebar changes; desktop rail does not block input; normal keys remain owned by xterm
behavior.appearance: Existing per-project phantom:studio:<id>; shared shell atmosphere; content opaque; focused intensity multiplied by .12
behavior.continuity: Sidebar width never writes camera/layout/selection; focus geometry is transient; PTY/session identity remains host-owned

motion.name: sidebar
motion.purpose: Desktop width; narrow drawer transform only

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: New transitions disabled and existing shell motion minimized

components.name: Shell primary button
components.description: Iris action on opaque dark surface, native typography.

components.name: Sidebar toggle
components.description: Always-visible header control with expanded state and target; 224px/56px desktop rail.
components.html: <button class="ds-toggle" aria-label="Plegar navegación" title="Plegar navegación" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="ds-sidebar">←</button><nav id="ds-sidebar" aria-label="Navegación">Proyectos</nav>

narrative.overview: Continuous graphite workspace with a compact collapsible sidebar, integrated header and floating controls. Existing personal atmosphere spans the shell; working content remains opaque. This replaces the obsolete light-theme sidecar.
keyCharacteristics: Short ease-out motion and reduced-motion support
Real terminal continuity and explicit map return

rules.name: Selection is state
rules.body: Use iris for selection and focus; accompany status color with text.

rules.name: Continuous canvas
rules.body: Avoid structural seams and nested cards; use opaque working content and quiet frames.

dos: Preserve terminal ownership and durable identities.
Keep project appearance separate from the global sidebar preference.
Use current controller evidence for verification claims.
donts: Do not infer mobile readiness or visual approval.
Do not use fixture screenshots as shipping artwork.
Do not animate or remount xterm to collapse navigation.
